results.claim: On the type-2 CARS resource path, after the asynchronous read completes, FUN_00111cd0 obtains the compressed byte count, calls FUN_00101690 on the input buffer, replaces object field +0x40 with the decompressed output, and calls FUN_0022acc8.
FUN_00101690 treats the first 32-bit input word as decompressed output length and runs a zlib inflate stream over input bytes starting at offset 4.
The decompressed CARS PTG buffer uses the same measured size-prefix-plus-zlib wrapping profile as the archive's per-file extraction records.
